description: The ACM-68000 signal for a listed security in its home market: ACM-200 TRADING (on the register), ACM-404 NOT ON THE REGISTER, ACM-451 READ THE FILING (a regulatory filing in the last three days, named), A bare ticker naming more than one issuer returns no signal but its candidates (add the exchange); a GTIN is ACM-404 (not a listed-security identifier: ask gtinfetch.ai); a home node that does not answer returns an error, never a signal. ACM-000, ACM-300 and ACM-500 are reserved (ACM-68000 v1.1) and never served. ACM-403 HALTED is advisory: the nodes carry no halt flag yet, so the answer links the market's halts page. Each signal has its page at https://acm-<code>.ai/.

identifier.description: ISIN (best), ticker with exchange (TSX:SHOP, SHEL.L), LEI or CMR key.
